name: Beremend (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Beremend (a shield of blue and red with two white ploughshares, a yellow lion and a yellow bell) within a wreath of oak branches, above a red scroll inscribed BEREMEND 1281.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
